summary: 0.31.0 entry misses the readability bar the human approved (~20 short lines: summary, 4 Breaking, 3 Added, 2 Fixed, 3 Upgrading). It has 7 Breaking, 6 Added, 7 Changed, 4 Fixed and 3 Upgrading bullets of ~290 chars each, with field lists repeated (statusVersion 4 `briefs` fields, the 14 option names again in the Breaking bullet and again in the table). Content is complete (nothing a user must do is lost; no slugs/modules/rounds/bench numbers), so this is about density. Cut: (a) the `canon search` / `canon trace` Added bullets (lines 36-40) to one line each: what the command does and its one-line usage; drop the `hits[]/neighbors[]/edges[]` field lists, node-id grammar, edge names (`re-review`, `fix-reviewed`, ...), and the `.canon/index` rebuild/in-memory/unreadStores/exit-code details; (b) Breaking: merge the two brief-format bullets and the waiver bullet into one; drop the heading list and the `brief` object field list from the statusVersion bullet (keep 'read `briefs`, statusVersion 4'); merge the two adapter exit-code bullets; (c) Changed: reduce the subject-judging paragraph to one sentence and drop the minor refusal-code bullets (demo init, install-hooks, approval-payload, strategy rollback, report build, dashboard hint) or fold them into one 'Several commands now exit 2 for bad input' line; (d) Fixed: keep the CONFIG_MISSING one, drop the three minor ones. Upgrading is fine as is.
